row: America’s Heartland shares the story of American agriculture and the hardworking men and women who bring food, fiber, and fuel to the nation and the world. We’ve captured stories in all 50 states and followed U.S. farmers as they bring their products to overseas markets. America’s Heartland is produced by PBS KVIE in Sacramento, California.
